reviews.title: Pathetic Ride services
reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointing Service by Yango Drivers!

The behavior of many Yango drivers is absolutely pathetic. They appear to be more interested in waiting for higher fares than accepting the rides already offered by the company. Even when drivers are nearby, responding to ride requests, and clearly able to see the pickup location, they refuse to accept the ride and keep waiting for the fare to increase. Meanwhile, customers are left waiting for hours just to get a single ride. This is unacceptable, unprofessional, and extremely frustrating.

Yango must take responsibility and introduce a proper accountability system. If a driver is nearby, available, and has no ongoing ride, the app should require a reasonable response to ride requests and monitor repeated refusals or cancellations. Drivers who deliberately ignore reasonable ride requests while waiting for higher fares should be investigated, and appropriate action should be taken where misuse is established.

Customers should not have to waste hours of their valuable time because drivers are unwilling to accept the fare offered through the platform. Yango needs to prioritize customer convenience, enforce service standards, and stop allowing this kind of experience to damage its reputation. We need reliable rides, not endless waiting!

Drivers have also stopped too far away from the location I’ve set on the app (one of which proceeded to call yelling at me). reviews.title: Being cheated
reviews.text:
Today, I had a very disappointing experience with Yango. Before starting the ride, the fare shown in the app was Rs. 480. The driver picked us up from the selected pickup location and dropped us off at our home without taking any extra route or covering any additional distance.

However, when we reached our destination, the final fare had suddenly increased to Rs. 1,040. An extra Rs. 543 was added under the “extra distance” charge, even though we did not travel any additional distance beyond the original route.

This fare increase is unfair and incorrect. I request Yango to investigate this issue and refund the incorrect extra charge as soon as possible.

reviews.title: Items Stolen During My Move – Yango Refused to help
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing and unacceptable experience with Yango.

I hired movers through the Yango app to move my belongings. After the move, I discovered that several items were missing, including valuable personal property. When I reported the incident, instead of taking responsibility and investigating the matter, Yango simply provided me with the driver’s phone number and told me to handle the issue myself.

I repeatedly contacted customer support expecting a proper investigation, accountability, and assistance. Instead, the conversation was closed without any meaningful action, leaving me alone to deal with a potential theft that occurred during a service booked and paid for through their platform.

A company cannot profit from connecting customers with service providers and then refuse to assist when serious complaints arise. Customer safety, trust, and property protection should be a priority, not something customers are forced to handle on their own.

I am extremely dissatisfied with the way this case was handled and will be escalating the matter through the relevant consumer protection authorities while sharing my experience publicly to warn others.

I would strongly advise anyone considering Yango moving services to think carefully before trusting them with valuable belongings.

reviews.text: I deleted the Application around 10:45 pm to preserve my battery as I was away from a charger. I didn’t accept the order, I never spoke to the Driver. He kept calling the number long after the application was deleted. My phone was charging and finally he came to my mother in law’s home and started shouting that I had made an offer and I didn’t pick up the phone and to give him his due money. Now, I am away and outside and my honor and dignity are being chewed and vomited by an outsider, whom I didn’t even spoke to or agree to that please come and pick. He made such a huge drama at my mother in law’s place, and kept insisting that his time was wasted and to pay him whatever his cost was. I felt so harassed over the phone call that I asked him, when did you speak to me, or confirm with me where to come, and I told him I had deleted the application to save battery life. He kept insisting that I had offered him and the company had offered him so it doesn’t matter. Please, train them with basic courtesy and basic logic, and I don’t want to be associated with Yango anymore.

reviews.title: Badest experience in rent
reviews.text:
I rented a car through Yango and paid a 1000 AED deposit, but I was redirected to a third-party company called Amex Car Rental, which actually provided the car.

The first issue was that the car I received was completely different from what I had booked. Despite complaining multiple times, they refused to replace it. During the rental period, their customer service was also unresponsive regarding basic service-related issues.

Now the situation has gotten worse. The car received fines, but according to Parkin, these fines will be waived within 5 days. Even after informing the company about this, they still insist that I must pay 50 AED per fine as an “admin fee,” which makes no sense since the fines will be removed.

The worst part is that they remotely disabled the car at 7 PM while it was parked on the street, without any proper notice. This is extremely unprofessional and unsafe. On top of that, their staff is rude on the phone and completely unwilling to help resolve the issue.

Overall, this was a very bad experience, and I would strongly not recommend using this service, especially when dealing with third-party rental companies like this.

reviews.title: Unprofessional
reviews.text:
I chose Yango expecting a smoother and more professional experience, but unfortunately, it was the opposite.

I booked a car through the app for a 6-month period, but I was surprised to find that my booking history had been deleted. On top of that, the rental company started contacting me directly to change the agreement, which created confusion and concern.

Trying to communicate with Yango was extremely frustrating — their customer service is among the worst I’ve experienced in Dubai. There was a clear lack of transparency, and instead of resolving the issue, Yango stepped back, leaving me to handle everything on my own.

Apps like this are supposed to simplify life, but in my case, it did the opposite. The experience was stressful, unprofessional, and disappointing.

There is really no need to use this app when you can get better service, better prices, and much more reliable customer support from alternatives like Udrive and Invigo.

I would not recommend Yango based on my experience.

reviews.title: SHAME!! Scammers & most horrible customer service ever!!👎🏽
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience.

This situation was genuinely surprising for a platform operating under the Yango / Yandex brand.

The payment was charged immediately after booking, yet no one contacted me regarding the vehicle pickup. Only after reaching out to customer support did their partner respond, with unclear communication and no precise pickup details.

I was simply instructed to go to a large shopping mall, without any exact location provided. When I requested clarification, the partner became unresponsive. Even close to the scheduled pickup time, no proper information was shared.

As a result, the booked service was effectively not delivered.

What is particularly concerning is that customer support initially acknowledged the issue and confirmed that the amount would be credited back due to the service failure. However, when I later attempted to proceed with another booking, this commitment was reversed, and the previously communicated resolution was no longer honored.

The entire experience felt inconsistent and unreliable, which is very unexpected from a brand of this scale.

I have been a repeat customer, including long-term rentals, which makes this experience even more disappointing.

This is not the level of service one would expect from Yango / Yandex. 

Shame on you!!! СТЫД И ПОЗОР!!! 👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽

reviews.title: Horrible cab service, scammers
reviews.text:
I booked a ride with only one stop during peak hours, and the fare was clearly shown as 1156 rupees before confirming the ride. However, after the ride ended, the app suddenly showed a total amount of 1333 rupees without any proper explanation or fare breakdown.

This has been one of the most horrible cab service experiences I’ve ever had. The app keeps charging extra fares without providing proper ride details or transparency. There is no proper customer support helpline, and the agents are extremely unhelpful. They fail to provide any proof or justification for the extra charges and only send scripted replies instead of resolving the issue.

This kind of behavior shows a complete lack of accountability and professionalism. I will never use this app again and would not recommend it to anyone. Please think twice before downloading.

reviews.title: Very disappointing experience with the app’s routing system.
reviews.text:
The app selects longer routes even when shorter alternatives are available. In urgent situations, this creates unnecessary delay. Drivers are simply following the app’s navigation, so this is a system issue, not a driver issue.

However, the complaint and rating system only impacts the driver, with no clear way to report routing or algorithm errors. This results in penalties to drivers for faults beyond their control.

Yango should provide transparency in route selection and a separate channel to report app-level issues.

reviews.title: Unreliable service and poor
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience with Yango Drive. I booked a 9-seater vehicle and made the payment upfront. Two days later—long after they had taken my money—they contacted me to say the car I booked was unavailable. To make matters worse, they tried to "resolve" the issue by offering a 7-seater instead. If I booked a 9-seater, it’s because I have 9 people to transport. Offering a smaller car is not a solution; it’s a logistical nightmare. Very unprofessional to confirm a booking and take payment without actually securing the vehicle. I won’t be using them again.

reviews.title: Pathetic support
reviews.text: I have been using this app for a while but their support is pathetic and beyond reasoning. I had a ride from point A to point B in Rs350 and the same ride costed me Rs991 on the same day. When I contacted the support they accepted that it’s their fault due to GPS error and yet they are not being able to provide the refund. They are constantly switching the conversation and blaming the driver? It should have a simple solution to just refund the extra amount which was charged but they don’t want to return the money. To whomever considering them think twice.

reviews.title: Very poor customer service
reviews.text: I never had an issue with using their app for while. Recently I faced two issues; once the driver canceling the ride on me when I was coming to the car (for the reason I didn’t pick up the phone, even though I haven’t canceled my ride on the app). And today I booked comfort, it showed me 16 dhs to my house (it’s 12 normally with taxi but there were none available) I confirmed - they took 38 dhs from me after the ride! I talk to customer service, they keep this bot response going, and after a few mins they just ghost you! Their quality of service is declining very badly for a regular user like me!

reviews.title: Cannot redeem the cashback points and unable to call the driver
reviews.text:
While overall the app is ok, there are few bugs and zero customer support.

I have subscribed for Yango Plus (bundled together with Noon), and while I’m receiving the cashback points, I’m not able to redeem them (I’ve followed all the instructions, including those given by Support Team) and every time receive an error message that an active Yango Plus subscription is required.

Moreover, when I reached out to customer support, they gave basic instructions on how to “turn on” redemption (which I’ve already explained as non-working), and then was simply sent to reach out to Customer Care of Yango Play through WhatsApp where no one replies my messages for 2 days.

Disappointing and I hope the mentioned issues can be fixed soon.

reviews.title: Extremely Unsafe Ride & Unprofessional Support
reviews.text:
I had one of the most disturbing and unsafe experiences with Yango. I booked a ride for a female friend early in the morning. The driver immediately demanded extra cash above the app fare. During the ride, he behaved rudely, acted sketchy, and kept staring at her in a way that made her feel extremely unsafe. At the end of the trip, he locked the car using child lock, refused to let her out, and then demanded even more money. After she finally got out, he stood outside giving her threatening looks.

I contacted Yango support and the experience was just as bad. Multiple representatives called, none provided a case ID or took responsibility, and everyone acted like they wanted to avoid the issue entirely. No professionalism, no resolution, and no concern for customer safety.

This is absolutely unacceptable for a ride-hailing service. Safety should be the minimum expectation. I will not be using Yango again until they fix their service and take rider safety seriously.

Can you please explain why you charge paid waiting time from the very first minute? But what about drivers who drive away from you for 30 minutes circling around, you call them several times, they say “yes, yes” without any clear explanation of why they drove away from you, you’re wasting time and then they just blow you off and drive to a gas station away from you and say wait another 15 minutes. So why is there zero accountability and financial compensation for such drivers, but these same drivers turn on paid waiting time without even reaching you? Yandex, are you out of your mind?

reviews.title: They took the money, but didn’t provide the service!
reviews.text:
I booked a car for October 1st through October 31st. I selected a car and filled out all the necessary information. Days passed, but no one contacted me, and no information was received on the appointed day (even though they took the reservation fee). A few days later, I contacted support. They only sympathized and said, «How sorry they are that I’m in this situation,» but they still didn’t resolve the issue. A day later, support stopped responding. A little while later, I contacted support again, and they sympathized again, but still didn’t resolve the issue. Even though the app says the reservation is active and I’m using the car.
I don’t know whose fault it is—Yango or the company that provides the cars—but the fact that support isn’t addressing the issue is disastrous!

reviews.title: Very Bad Experiences from Sharjah
reviews.text:
I have used Yango’s service around ten times, and that my recent two experiences have been extremely disappointing. Both times, the drivers were arrogant, unprofessional, and purposefully took wrong routes even after clear instructions. When questioned, they spoke loudly and disrespectfully, giving unacceptable excuses like “we are new to the city.”

This level of service is completely unacceptable, especially considering how smooth and pleasant my experiences were during Yango’s initial launch period. It’s quite clear that the quality of drivers and overall supervision have declined drastically.

Such behavior reflects a serious lack of training, monitoring, and customer care. If this continues, Yango risks losing loyal customers who once trusted the service. I hope the management takes immediate action to improve driver conduct and restore the high standards.
